thread:
Ivy: Quick heads-up  compact playground on narrow widths: when streaming the token counter width shifts, Stop/Regenerate chips slip under quick-actions, and picking a prompt from the library sometimes restarts the stream. Small gif attached: https://files.internal/s/compact-stream-bounce.gif
Marcus: Repro on 320px. Token pill moves because digits change width; composer rehydrate kills the websocket session on prompt insert.
Jo: Two low-risk fixes: (1) reserve space for counter using monospace + min-width; (2) debounce UI updates so we don't reflow on every partial chunk. Also prototyping two UX options: floating circular stop (44px) vs sticky bottom action bar.
Sasha: For the counter: CSS suggestion: ```css .token-pill { font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; min-width: 5ch; text-align: right; } ``` This plus client-side throttle (120-150ms) should stop the jump.
Lee: Prompt library insert currently does a full composer replace. Suggest an insertText API: patch textarea value + caret, keep stream session-id. If unavoidable, snapshot session token and call resume instead of fresh generation.
Ivy: Accessibility notes?
accessibility-bot: Accessibility checklist: - Icon-only controls must have aria-labels (aria-label="Stop generation", aria-label="Regenerate response"). - Floating or bottom controls must be keyboard reachable (tabindex=0) and show a visible focus ring. - Provide Esc to stop, and expose a keyboard shortcut for regen. - Streaming content: use aria-live="polite" and provide a manual "Announce latest" control that uses assertive when pressed. - Announce token thresholds with counts ("Tokens used: 820 of 1024 (80%)").
Marcus: UX trade-offs: bottom bar is more reachable on large thumbs but could occlude attachments/composer; floating top-right is discoverable and less intrusive but competes with quick-actions. We should prototype both and run quick reachability tests.
Jo: Mock plan: (A) floating circular stop pinned to message frame top-right, 44px diameter, shadow + z-index; (B) sticky bottom bar with Stop + Regenerate centered, hide when composer focused. I'll add both to the prototype with high-contrast variants.
Sasha: Implementation plan: 1) add monospace + min-width + placeholder digits to token pill, 2) throttle updates to 120ms (rAF batch fallback 200ms), 3) implement insertText api to avoid rehydrate, 4) add floating stop + bottom-bar prototypes, 5) add a11y acceptance tests.
Lee: Pseudo for throttle: ```js let last=0, pending=false; function onChunk(n){ last=n; if(!pending){ pending=true; setTimeout(()=>{ renderToken(last); pending=false },120) } } ```
Ivy: Will we also change copy? visible label = "Stop" for brevity, aria-label = "Stop generation" for screen readers?
accessibility-bot: That pattern is recommended: short visible copy + descriptive aria-label. For regenerate: visible "Regenerate", aria-label "Regenerate response".
Marcus: I'll own the token UI + throttle PR. Lee will own insertText + session-preserve. Jo to deliver prototypes. Sasha to own a11y checklist and run VoiceOver/TalkBack tests.
Jo: Prototype link when ready: https://playground.internal/proto/compact-stopbar-2418 (includes mobile + keyboard overlays).
Ivy: Thanks team  tagging beta once PRs land. Keeping this thread open for follow-ups and quick user testing results.
